environment.coverage: Fresh disposable game sessions and a separate installed-0.9 regression; personal saves were not loaded or copied.

limits: Installed 0.9 baseline and current 1.0 source tests are distinct evidence surfaces; a 1.0 installed build is not yet claimed here.
The 1.0 native tests use disposable game sessions and do not prove compatibility with every personal save or mod load order.
Native UI interfaces were called; every control was not physically clicked at every resolution.
No complete world rewrite, general frame-rate measurement, hosted multiplayer or single-file licensed Morrowind game was tested.
